# BSC (Bharat Steel Group) — Sales Call Knowledge Base (auto-distilled)

## Corpus summary

This corpus is a large, mixed bag of call snippets. The majority are **not genuine sales conversations** — they are logistics/transport coordination (trailer booking in Raipur/Nagpur/Tirupati), loading/unloading disputes, driver coordination, TC/MTC document chasing, payment-follow-up and collections calls, wrong numbers, and internal admin chatter. Only a minority of calls are real customer-facing sales interactions (rate enquiry, negotiation, order placement, dealer/stockist calls). This note draws **only** on those genuine sales threads — chiefly: SRC Project Site (Pugazhenthi), Subhraa Metal, Sri Murugan Hardware, Sri Vinayaga Steel, Vinayaga Steel (Pradeep), Surya Raja (VLT Trading), Thangaraj Metfra, TAMILARASAN KUMAR, SS Natarajan, Uniqcore Const (Balakrishnan), V R Earth Movers, Tirupati Balasubramaniam (Telugu-mixed dealer calls), Sun Construction (Saveetha College), Vadivel/Sangeetha Traders, Vidveda Krishnasamy, and a handful of English B2B enquiries (Sumit Bhandari, Steffy/Petro Saks, Syed Rahamathulla, Yashil Shah). Given the dominance of non-sales operational chatter, this KB stays tightly grounded in what is actually said and keeps conclusions conservative.

## Products & brand ladder

BSC deals almost entirely in **long and flat MS/TMT steel products**, sold mostly as "sale" (secondary) make with occasional primary brands passed through:

- **TMT rebar** — core product. Sizes 8/10/12/16/20/25/32 mm discussed repeatedly (e.g., "8 mm 72, 10 mm 70, 12 mm 68" — Plant Senthil call; "FE 500... 550D... RNL" — Velmurugan Subbaiyan, Yashil Shah). Brands referenced: **Suryadev/RINL(Vizag)**, **SAIL**, **JSW**, **Sail/Vizag primary**. One prospect explicitly asked for primary brands only: *"We are dealing primary make only, Sail and Vizag"* (Subhrangshu Ghosh call) and rejected secondary (Suryoday/Polag).
- **MS Plates (HR plates/checkered plates)** — thickness 4/5/6/8/10/12/16/20/22/25/36/40 mm, grades **E250 BR, E350 BR, 250D**; sold as coil-cut or standard plate (sizes like 1250×2500/6300 mm). Frequent size-cutting/"sharing size" requests (Thangaraj Metfra calls) and coil-vs-plate distinctions (TAMILARASAN KUMAR calls: "full coil 20 ton... end bit... ₹500 கம்மியாகும்").
- **Structural steel** — **Angle, Channel (ISMC), Beam/Joist (ISMB/NPB), RHS/SHS/square-rectangular pipe** — angle and channel confirmed as regularly stocked ("TMT angle, channel உம் இருக்கு" — Srivas consultant); square tube/RHS/pipe explicitly **not dealt in** by BSC (Srivas, Thirisha Enterprise, Velarasu calls: "pipes நம்ம deal பண்றது இல்ல").
- **MS Flats** — sizes like 50×5, 100×5/6 (Yasar Feroz Godown call).
- **HR coils / cut-to-size sheets** — company does coil-to-plate cutting with cutting charges (₹500/ton mentioned in Steffy Suresh/Petro Saks call) and "coil to coil" discount (₹500/ton cheaper when customer takes full coil incl. end-bit/scrap).
- Items explicitly **not stocked**: square tube, bolts/hangers (sale make doesn't do angle bolts), SHS/RHS pipe, net/washer, CR coldron sheet (sourced via referral, not BSC stock), SAE1045/EN8 special grades.

**Brand ladder** observed: Primary (SAIL, Vizag/RINL, Tata Steel, JSW, Apollo pipe) > Secondary/"sale" (local re-rolled, house brand) which BSC primarily transacts in for TMT/plates/structural at lower price points, sold ex-work + GST + transport/loading extra.

## Real rates & terms (only rates that actually appear in the calls)

- TMT: "8 mm 72, 10 mm 70, 12 mm 68" (+tax, transport extra) — Plant Senthil.
- TMT: 50mm angle "இன்னைக்கு rate 65" +tax — Srivas consultant.
- TMT: 68+tax (10 ton order) — Sun Construction Saveetha.
- TMT (CRS/Sail 20mm): "₹70 + tax" — Sun Construction.
- TMT dealer (Tirupati): 16mm ₹68–69, 12mm 65, 8mm 70–71, 10mm 68–69, all "plus loading/transport" — Tirupati Balasubramaniam threads.
- TMT (Vizag): "16, 20, 25 — 65; 12mm 67; 10mm 68/69; 8mm 70" — VJR Developers call.
- TMT (Thirumala Steel Vizag): 12mm ₹63,000 + loading(₹325)+transport ≈ ₹654/₹679 delivered.
- MS plate (checkered): ₹65,000 + GST — T Ravikumar/German Polymers.
- MS plate 6mm: ₹64/kg, "2 meter-னா ₹1500 ஜாஸ்தி" — Subhraa Metal (260918).
- HR plate 8mm (Sumit Bhandari): 250BR ₹67,300 door delivery, final price, with note of ₹1500/ton NMDC-linked increase expected.
- Plate rate ladder (United Gummudiponndi / Vinayaga Steel Pradeep): market "₹61... 2.5/3mm same rate ₹61–61.5, 2mm ₹63".
- Structural 250 High Beam (Thirisha Enterprise): "62,500 + GST, loading, transport extra" — Sail make, ~80 ton requirement.
- Uniqcore plate order: revised quote 71,750 / 73,750 / 75,750 (size-tiered), finally approved at 75,750 — "straight rate, no further cut."
- Cutting charge: ₹500/ton extra for size-cutting plates (Petro Saks/Steffy call).
- Coil-to-coil discount: ₹500/ton cheaper if customer takes full coil incl. end-bit/scrap vs cut plate.
- Payment terms: Sumangala Steel repeatedly told **"advance payment only, not credit"** for a particular supplier relationship; BSC's own customers (Subhraa Metal, V R Earth Movers) operate on **advance/online transfer before dispatch**, with rate validity windows (e.g., "இன்னைக்கே rate validity முடியுது").
- Rate-hike pattern: multiple calls reference monthly increases of **₹1000–₹2000 per ton** (Subhraa Metal, V R Earth Movers, Surya Raja) tied to NMDC/primary mill price moves.

## Objection Playbook

1. **"Rate too high / reduce price"**
   - Pattern: customer asks for ₹1–3/kg or flat ₹100–500/ton cut; BSC/sales rep holds firm citing "margin இல்ல," then offers a small concession (₹1–1.5/kg or ₹200–500 flat) bundled with transport inclusion.
   - Example line used by rep: *"இதுல அவ்வளவுதான் சார் கிடைக்குது, இதுல margin இல்ல சார் அந்த அளவுக்கு"* [That's all margin we have left, sir, not much room].
   - Counter used against pushy regulars: *"increase பண்ணி கொடுத்துட்டு கம்மி பண்றது எல்லாம் பண்ண மாட்டோம்"* [We don't discount after we've already marked up] (VASUDEVAN K call) — framed as fairness/consistency.

2. **"Why is rate increasing every month?"**
   - Response: attribute to **mill-level (NMDC/primary) price hikes**, not company margin: *"rate increase ஆகுதுன்னு சொல்றாங்க"* and advise urgency to lock in before next hike (Subhraa Metal 260928: "delay பண்ணீங்கன்னா next month rate increase ஆகும்ன்னு சொல்லத்தான் call பண்ணேன்").

3. **"Give credit instead of advance"**
   - Firm refusal pattern: *"Credit-ல தர மாட்டார் sir. Only advance payment தான்"* — rep repeatedly checks with management but outcome stays advance-only (Sumangala Steel calls).

4. **Stock/quantity objections — "small quantity not economical to cut"**
   - Recurrent theme on plate/coil orders: minimum tonnage needed to justify a coil cut (e.g., "6 ton கிட்ட இருந்தால் தான் coil cut பண்ணி கொடுக்க முடியும்"); small orders redirected to standard sizes or told to wait for bulk consolidation.

5. **Delivery delay due to driver/holiday/festival**
   - Honest framing used with customer: driver shortage due to festival leave, stock only for 2 days, offering alternative — customer arranges own vehicle if urgent (Sumangala Steel Radhakrishnan 261001).

6. **Grade/brand mismatch (tag/TC disputes)**
   - When customer flags SAIL tag vs Vizag material mismatch, rep promises to re-issue correct TC/endorsement and have it couriered — showing a document-correction routine rather than denial (Uniqcore Vinoth calls).

7. **Competitor price comparisons ("JSW Panther rate is 64, can you match?")**
   - Rep holds line on delivered-rate vs competitor's possibly ex-work rate, explains local demand/competition dynamics rather than matching blindly (Tirupati Balasubramaniam 261021/261022: "Chennai-ல material demand இருக்கு... இங்க AP-ல demand இல்ல").

## Effective Lines (openings, discovery, closing, follow-up)

**Opening / identification**
- *"சொல்லுங்க sir/Madam"* — universal neutral opener, lets caller state need immediately.
- *"Bharat Steel-ல இருந்து call பண்றேன்"* — clear company identification builds trust fast (Sugumar Elevarasan call).

**Discovery questions used well**
